rationale: G is an upstream frozen reference established in Phase21.
The Phase29 scientific focus is reproducibility of the BARR conditional regional mechanism.
Faithfully retraining canonical G would require reproducing its original training population semantics, which predate the ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT / ROUTER_HOLDOUT split.
Phase29 must preserve the Phase30 one-shot ROUTER_HOLDOUT lock.
Holding G fixed isolates downstream stochastic variability instead of conflating it with global-backbone variability.
